summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Renovation Calculator feature for Max Q platform. Backend: 13/13 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All key calculator UI features verified working.

minor.issue: Returns 403 when property limit reached - expected behavior but test had to use existing property

seed_data_creation: Used existing property PROP-325A18C4 with calculation
context_for_next_testing_agent: Renovation calculator fully implemented and tested. Backend APIs working: tenant login, property CRUD, calculate, get calculation, switch floor option, switch wall scenario, toggle items. Frontend UI has all sections: Vloerwerken, Muurwerken, Plafondwerken, Elektriciteit, Sanitair (bathroom only), Overig. Radio buttons for floor options work correctly. Wall scenario buttons switch scenarios correctly. Extra opties are collapsible. 65 work items in DB, 22 with labels.

POST /api/auth/tenant/login.details: Returns {success, user, token, role} with JSON body {username, password}

POST /api/properties.details: Creates property with rooms, returns {message, property_id}

POST /api/properties/{id}/calculate.details: Generates calculation using live DB prices. Returns calculation_id, totals, rooms_calculated, work_items_used

GET /api/properties/{id}/calculation.details: Returns full calculation with room_calculations, each containing floor_items, wall_items, ceiling_items, other_items

PUT /api/properties/{id}/calculation/swi.details: Switches floor finish options (tiles/parquet/laminate/vinyl). Uses query params: room_id, option_group, selected_item_id
Switches wall scenarios (nieuw_pleisterwerk/egaliseren/gyproc). Returns 400 for invalid scenario

PUT /api/properties/{id}/calculation/ite.details: Toggles individual items on/off, recalculates totals

Frontend Calculator UI.details: All sections present: Vloerwerken (30m²), Muurwerken (57.2m²), Plafondwerken, Elektriciteit, Sanitair (bathroom), Overig

Floor Options Radio Buttons.details: 4 options visible: tegelen: standaard (€2,850), parket (€1,950), laminaat (€1,050), vinyl (€2,040) with radio button selection

Wall Scenario Buttons.details: 3 buttons: Nieuw pleisterwerk, Egaliseren, Gyproc afwerking - switch correctly with visual highlight

Extra Opties Collapsible.details: Found collapsible extras for muur and plafond sections. Shows 'Extra opties (5)' with '1 geselecteerd' badge

DB Price Integration.details: Calculation items have work_item_id linking to database. Items without labels are skipped.
